Results.ReviewText: I've owned Weber grills for over 30 years. In that time I've recommended Weber to all my family and friends. This new grill has been erratic. Much of the time it struggles to reach a temperature above 350 and I'm forced to babysit it experimenting turning on different combinations of the 3 burners to get a consistent temperature. This was never necessary with my former 3 burner Genesis which I passed on to my son and it still continues to perform well for him. Needless to say so far I am underwhelmed.

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill about a month ago.  I like all the features and the quality seems to be good so far.  The biggest problem is temperature control with all three burners on.   The lowest temperature I get is around 600 F with the burners running at the lowest gas setting on the knobs.  If I turn the knob below "low", the burner shuts off.  To achieve lower temperature, I must turn one or more burners off which means the temperature distribution is lousy, hot on the burner that is on, colder on the burner that is off.  

This means practically, I have no temperature control because the grill is running extremely hot even at its lowest setting.  Which means burnt food on the outside and raw on the inside. This is a deal breaker.
Results.Title: No temperature control - don't buy

Results.ReviewText: I bought my Weber Spirt E-310 in early July.  Have used it at least three times per week cooking burgers, chicken, fish, and steak.  Everything has turned out great. No flame flair ups or burnt chicken skin.  This is my fourth grill in the past 45 years and by for the best.  The burner design is the secret to the flame problems.  If your going to buy a gas grill don’t waste your money on the less expensive grills you will regret your decision and in the long run save money by buying the right grill the first time.  Buy WEBER
Results.Title: Exceptional Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber grill. It does a great job grilling, heats up face and the grates are nice and sturdy.  I wish that Weber would start including side burners for keeping sauces warm or cooking up a side dish.  Also, the side tray/tables do not fold down; a huge design flaw because it makes moving the grill to another location beyond cumbersome if you have to carry it.  The biggest problem is the propane tank and gauge connector hook.  Clearly this was not designed with women in mind.  It takes quite a bit of shoulder strength to lift a full propane tank onto that little gauge hook....not cool.  I can’t do it myself.  It would be easier if the grill had a full bottom instead of that hole cut out, for women anyway.  Instead of having to jigger the heavy tank onto the gauge (which you must do otherwise the tank sits on the ground thanks to the big cut out), couldn’t you find a way to connect the gauge to the tank? I know it works by weight, but trying to maneuver that inside the tiny cabinet space is just awful.  Love the way it cooks but for what they charge it should be much easier installing a propane tank. The gas line connector is fine and very easy; I am referring to the gauge that keeps track of the amount of propane.  I would definitely recommend this grill to strong men or ladies who have them, but not to single women.  Even the guy from the stor had trouble  getting the tank positioned correctly on that hook.
Results.Title: Great for grilling but several design flaws

Really makes grilling easy with that extra third burner, and very even heat distribution (my old Genesis Silver only had two burners). If this one lasts nearly as long, I will be very pleased, and Weber is the brand that withstands the test of time......as I have already experienced.

Only suggestion:  the drip tray under the grill (the tray, not the disposable pan) is hard to slide out.  You have to open the door JUST RIGHT in order to slide it out.  You could do better, guys!

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
